title: SemMask: Semantic-Prioritized Progressive Masking for Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.19560v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) are designed to enable globally parallel generation. However, in practice, they often exhibit pseudo-autoregressive behavior and a function-word-first bias, which undermines their performance on tasks such as text writing and code generation that benefit from global planning and parallel decoding. To address this, we propose SemMask, a novel fine-tuning paradigm that leverages a semantic-prioritized progressive masking strategy to encourage the model to decode high-information semantic tokens early and globally, thereby enhancing its global planning and parallel generation capabilities. Specifically, we first use the gradients of the original DLM with respect to each token to identify semantic tokens. During masking, these semantic tokens are preserved with priority, establishing a progressive generation order in which semantic tokens are decoded prior to function tokens. translated_title: SemMask：面向扩散语言模型的语义优先渐进式掩码策略
translated_abstract: 扩散语言模型（DLMs）旨在实现全局并行生成。然而在实践中，它们往往表现出伪自回归行为和虚词优先的偏差，这削弱了其在文本写作和代码生成等受益于全局规划与并行解码的任务上的性能。为解决这一问题，我们提出了SemMask，这是一种新颖的微调范式，利用语义优先的渐进式掩码策略，鼓励模型尽早且全局地解码高信息量的语义token，从而增强其全局规划和并行生成能力。具体而言，我们首先利用原始DLM相对于每个token的梯度来识别语义token；在掩码过程中，这些语义token被优先保留，从而建立起一种渐进式生成顺序，使语义token先于虚词token被解码；同时，我们相应地调整了损失函数设计。
tldr: 提出SemMask微调范式，通过基于梯度识别语义token并进行语义优先的渐进式掩码，促使扩散语言模型优先解码高信息语义token，从而克服伪自回归与虚词优先偏差，增强全局规划与并行生成能力。
en_tdlr: SemMask is a fine-tuning paradigm that uses gradient-based semantic token identification and semantic-prioritized progressive masking to make diffusion language models decode high-information semantic tokens first, overcoming pseudo-autoregressive behavior and enhancing global planning and parallel generation.
